notablePrerequisites:
Brimstone Trebuchet has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a nonlegendary Knight.
description:
Activate Brimstone Trebuchet using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary Knight you control with haste.
When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Brimstone Trebuchet triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
